name: preparation-after-idle
description: Issue #49: preparation that ended a long while ago, given modules again (a file opened that imports one nothing prepared yet, a model loaded again), starts its stall clock afresh. 0.0.11 measured it from the last progress of the preparation before, so it was 'preparation-stalled ... made no progress for a minute (34/39 done)' five seconds after it began, and wrote a bundle.
